title: Conditional Logic with CASE
description: Add if-then-else logic directly inside SQL query select expressions using CASE WHEN.

blocks.content:
The `CASE` statement creates conditional column values:

```sql
SELECT name, score,
  CASE
    WHEN score >= 90 THEN 'Pass'
    ELSE 'Fail'
  END AS status
FROM tests;
```

blocks.prompt: Query all products: return `name`, `price`, and a new column `price_category` where price >= 100 is "Expensive", else "Affordable".
blocks.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, price REAL);
blocks.answer_sql: SELECT name, price, CASE WHEN price >= 100 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Affordable' END AS price_category FROM products;
